_help.how: Copy this object into the array in src/data/expressions.json, delete the _help key, and fill in every field. See the README.
_help.id: Unique, de-identified ID such as EX-012. Never use a participant's name or code.
_help.sample: Delete this key for real entries. Only illustrative examples set it to true.
_help.lenses: Which Language Lens codes this moment mainly bears on: any of N (Nomenclature), P (Proxy/Audience), T (Trust).
_help.fidelity.interpreter: One of: none-needed, research-coordinator, independent-interpreter, professional-translator. Leave empty if not recorded.
_help.fidelity.rendering: One of: verbatim, gloss, paraphrase. Leave empty if not recorded.
_help.fidelity.singleSource: false = a second interpreter read it the same way. true = rests on one person alone. null = not yet checked.
_help.rule: An entry missing any of the four fidelity tags is shown as 'Needs re-check' and cannot carry full confidence.
_help.sensitive: true if quoting, sharing, or design use could expose the participant or their family.
